description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotebookFragment class, which is a UI fragment responsible for displaying and handling interactions with a specific notebook in the note-taking app. It extends MainFragment and manages navigation to other screens such as the note editor and search, as well as validation of notebook existence.

classes.name: NotebookFragment
classes.description: A UI fragment for displaying and managing a specific notebook, handling navigation to note editor and search, and verifying notebook existence.

methods.name: actionToEditor
methods.description: Prepares navigation action to open the note editor with specified note details, attachments, and notebook context.

methods.name: actionToSearch
methods.description: Prepares navigation action to initiate a search with the specified query.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides the lifecycle method to check whether the notebook exists; navigates up if it does not.
